description: List the app's Secrets with their versions, when each was last set and whether each is declared, never their values. `missing` lists the Secrets declared and nobody has set: run in the project, those its peerlink.json declares, which a publish is refused until each is set; by app name, those the running release declares and runs without. To set one, the person runs `peerlink secret set NAME` themselves. Runs `peerlink secret list`.

app.description: App name; defaults to the app in this project's peerlink.json

dir.description: Project directory; defaults to the MCP server process cwd

name: secret_list
title: List an app's Secrets
